$comment: The pinned donation addresses (CAS-008, D46). Not a secret, and deliberately so.
Each entry names a chain, the address readers send to, the tokens accepted on
it, and the date of the small transfer that verified the address as the
owner's before it was pinned. The dashboard renders the address as text and as
a QR code from this same record, and refuses to render when the digest of the
entries differs from the one pinned in code: an address changes only in a
reviewed commit that changes both, never by editing a running instance.
The owner's rule for every entry: a wallet dedicated to this product, no
address shared with another venture's treasury or already public under
another identity, and one verification transfer per entry even where two
entries share a string. The addresses arrive by file, not in chat; until
then the list is empty and the page says so.
